competences.description: Attacks all enemies to decrease their Attack Power for 2 turns.

Grants Reflect Damage and Increase Critical Resistance on itself for 2 turns, and then attacks all enemies 3 times. Gains 1 stack of Chaos Force whenever attacking an enemy granted with Decrease Attack Power.

Attacks all enemies. Gains 5 stacks of Chaos Force if the boss is granted with a beneficial effect. When attacking enemies granted with Decrease Attack Power, Chaos Force increases by the number of those enemies.

Decreases the HP of all enemies by 1% per stack of Chaos Force, and then attacks all enemies with an attack that ignores all damage reduction effects. The damage dealt increases by 1% per stack of Chaos Force. This attack does not activate passive skills of the enemies.
